misc: Has a habit of getting lost on golf course grounds
Does not spit in the glass
biography: Janne enters the chronicles of the Hector Trophée as a delightfully confounding figure, bringing his talents from the picturesque grounds of Revontuli Golf to the esteemed pair competition across eight distinct editions. Characterized by an extraordinarily generous spirit that frequently leaves fellow competitors bewildered yet deeply appreciative, this gentleman treats everyone he encounters with utmost warmth, strictly adhering to the philosophy that one simply must not spit in the glass.

Despite his immense goodwill and vibrant presence on the links, Janne possesses a peculiarly charming flaw that has become legendary among his peers: a startling inability to navigate the simplest of pathways, resulting in a persistent habit of getting lost on golf course grounds just minutes before his starting time. While the coveted Hector Trophée and the individual brilliance of the Victor Trophy have thus far eluded his grasp across his eight tournament appearances, his ongoing participation in the community ensures that his uniquely disoriented journey continues to captivate observers.
